== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Barrier (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Rebel Barrier]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-rebel-barrier/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_Rebel_Barrier.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>bac791d4c307d0a67cc3d339e2ffac9866e2056e6ba910ddd2971f91dc46ed11</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
